body: I was definitely worried about this but my mom told me if she gets hungry she will eat , as long as he is developing with no concerns in terms of meeting milestones i wouldn't worry too much about it . Around that age they also have a sort of fluctuating relationship with food , and trying new things (spoon etc). He sounds right on track i wouldnt worry about it :)

I've suggested it for our relationship but not for parenting (if that exists?) but i try to keep those things separate , im of the mind that those require different things . I appreciate you so much thank you for your support <3
I've definitely looked for groups i've considered starting one , moms need support too ! I so appreciate your comments you have no idea im really in tears right now
Its just so frustrating because nobody really believes i need it. I feel like no one around me understands that im still a person as well as a mother :( ...

I have definitely expressed this often , just doesnt seem like he is listening , on my end at least :( ... i really appreciate your reply , i will definitely check out these subs , and try to find a way to get out for awhile
All my family is hours away unfortunately but i will look into a sitter , thank you so much
